nodes.name: CT pretreatment
nodes.procedure: The carbon textiles (CTs) were pretreated with concentrated HNO3 for 24 h to improve their hydrophilicity. Subsequently, the pretreated CTs were rinsed with distilled (DI) water and then dried in an oven at 70 °C for 5 h.

nodes.source_text: The carbon textiles (CTs) were purchased from CeTech Co.(Taiwan), and were pretreated with concentrated HNO3 for 24 h to improve their hydrophilicity. Subsequently, the pretreated CTs were rinsed with distilled (DI) water and then dried in an oven at 70 °C for 5 h.

nodes.name: Hydrothermal synthesis and calcination
nodes.procedure: Na2MoO4·2H2O (150 mg) and NiSO4·6H2O (162.5 mg) were dissolved in 80 mL DI water, then CH4N2S (400 mg) was added into the above solution and further stirred for 30 min. Further, the pretreated CTs were immersed in the mix solution which was transferred to a 100 mL Teflon-lined autoclave and heated for 15 h at 180 °C. The final products were rinsed with DI water, and then dried overnight in a vacuum oven at 60 °C. Finally, the precursor was calcined in Ar at 300 °C for 2 h at a rate of 1.5 °C/min to obtain the hierarchical NiMo3S4 heteroflowers on CTs.

nodes.characterization_summary: NiMo3S4 nanoflowers tightly stacked on CTs, each assembled from interconnected 2D nanoflakes with thickness 6-10 nm maintaining highly porous configuration.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Fig. 2a and 2b, NiMo3S4 nanoflowers are tightly stacked onto the skeleton of carbon textiles substrate... Fig. 2c shows the high magnification SEM image... NiMo3S4 nanoflakes with thickness of 6-10 nm are interconnected with each other, keeping a highly porous configuration.

nodes.characterization_summary: NiMo3S4 nanoflakes (6-10 nm thick) show lattice spacing of 9.2 Å for (002) planes with structural defects; MoS2 nanoflakes (10-20 nm thick) have 0.65 nm interlayer spacing.
nodes.evidence_snippet: the high-magnification TEM image and the corresponding fast Fourier transform (FFT) pattern show clear lattices with spacings of 9.2 Å, which agree with the (002) lattice planes... MoS2 nanoflakes is 10-20 nm, are composed of 9–12 layers of S-Mo-S with the normal interlayer spacing of 0.65 nm.

nodes.characterization_summary: Mo, S and Ni elements are evenly distributed throughout the NiMo3S4/CTs detection region.
nodes.evidence_snippet: To evaluate the uniform distribution of nickel atoms... EDS analysis were carried out. As shown in Fig. 2g, Mo, S and Ni elements are evenly distributed throughout the detection region.

nodes.characterization_summary: NiMo3S4/CTs shows diffraction peaks at 9.6° and 15.3° for (002) plane with calculated layer spacing of 9.2 Å; MoS2 shows (002) peak at 13.5° with 6.5 Å spacing; Ni3S2 shows cubic phase peaks.
nodes.evidence_snippet: For the NiMo3S4/CTs sample, the original MoS2 (002) peak at 13.5° isn't appear, but have two new diffraction peaks can be observed at 9.6° and 15.3°, which are attributable to the first- and second-order reflections of the layered NiMo3S4 (002) plane... calculated spacing between NiMo3S4 layers is about 9.2 Å compared with that of 6.5 Å in Ni-free MoS2 nanosheets.

nodes.characterization_summary: NiMo3S4/CTs shows E2g¹ and A1g modes shifted to 379.0 and 405.5 cm⁻¹ compared to MoS2 at 368.1 and 403.0 cm⁻¹, indicating fewer layers.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Compared with MoS2 nanosheets, the frequencies of the E2g¹ and A1g modes shift to 379.0 and 405.5 cm⁻¹ for the NiMo3S4/CTs sample, indicating that the layers are decreased of NiMo3S4 nanoflakes.

nodes.characterization_summary: NiMo3S4/CTs survey confirms Ni, Mo, S, C, O presence; Ni 2p3/2 at 856.2 eV, 2p1/2 at 874.4 eV (Ni²⁺); Mo 3d5/2 at 229.4 eV, 3d3/2 at 232.2 eV (Mo⁴⁺) with minor Mo⁶⁺; S 2p at 161.8-165.1 eV.
nodes.evidence_snippet: the survey scan spectrum confirms the presence of Ni, Mo, S, C and O elements... Ni 2p XPS spectra display two deconvoluted peaks of Ni 2p3/2 and Ni 2p1/2 centered at 856.2 and 874.4 eV... Mo 3d spectra display two major peaks at 229.4 and 232.2 eV... S 2p peaks at binding energies of 161.8, 163.1, 163.8 and 165.1 eV.

nodes.characterization_summary: NiMo3S4 has specific surface area of 34.62 m²/g and pore volume of 0.023 cm³/g; MoS2 has 20.51 m²/g and 0.016 cm³/g; Ni3S2 has 9.84 m²/g and 0.0023 cm³/g; all show type-IV isotherms with ~4 nm mesopores.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The specific surface area of NiMo3S4 sample (34.62 m² g⁻¹) is much larger than that of the pristine MoS2 (20.51 m² g⁻¹) and Ni3S2... The specific pore volume of the NiMo3S4 sample (~0.023 cm³ g⁻¹) is higher than that of the MoS2 (0.016 cm³ g⁻¹) and Ni3S2 [0.0023 cm³ g⁻¹].

nodes.characterization_summary: NiMo3S4/CTs shows double-layer capacitance Cdl of 30.6 mF cm⁻² (HER) and 31.2 mF cm⁻² (OER), corresponding to ECSA roughness factor RF=1530.
nodes.evidence_snippet: the NiMo3S4/CTs electrode displays a high areal capacitance of 30.6 mF cm⁻²... Cdl value of NiMo3S4/CTs is calculated to be 31.2 mF... The surface roughness factor (RF = Cdl/20 μF cm⁻²) was also evaluated... corresponding RF values are estimated to be 1530 (NiMo3S4/CTs).
